excluded_legs.leg: `scripts/hive-tooling-drill.sh` green, including this task's new cases.
excluded_legs.reason: The loop drill emits scratch spine events, which this instrument's own scope forbids, and it drives tmux. At this task's baseline the drill predates the tmux isolation that the task itself introduces, so running it necessarily creates sessions on the operator's live tmux server — the server holding every worker pane. An offline evaluation instrument must not carry that blast radius. The operator runs the drill against a green cell.

dod_legs.note: predictions_parse/predictions_verdict/predictions_coverage live in scripts/hive-common.sh (candidate.patch:151-258); hive-score's old inline regexes are deleted (candidate.patch:879-891) and it calls predictions_parse (hive-score:869 in patch), as does hive-launch's gate (artefacts/scripts/hive-launch:107). Proven both behaviourally and structurally: metrics-drill.log:112-126 — 'the gate's verdict and the scorer's record agree on eta/gamma', 'the parser lives in hive-common.sh', 'hive-launch/hive-score carries NO prediction regex of its own'.

Gate at hive-launch:107-147 runs before the WIP throttle (line 148), the order pin (line 239) and every emit (lines 294-304); unparseable exits 1 unless --anyway. metrics-drill.log:128-156 covers all four shapes: refuses 0-of-3 printing the four literal labels and the offending lines, names --anyway, provisioned nothing / wrote nothing back; no-section, declared-unpredicted and 2-of-3 all launch un-refused, the partial one warning loudly and naming the missed field.

predictions_coverage emits four distinct strings (candidate.patch:249-258). metrics-drill.log:94-102 asserts the literal strings for gamma (absent), eta (section present, 0 of 3 fields parsed) and theta (declared), plus an explicit check that the three are different strings.

hive-score:76-81 lowercases and accepts only clean|minor rework|rework, refusing up front (before the spine read and the append) with a message naming the three. metrics-drill.log:104-110: Rework->rework, 'Minor Rework'->'minor rework', bogus and the near-miss 'needs rework' refused, and a refused verdict wrote no entry.

hive-close step 6 (candidate.patch:92-121) runs strictly after the review.passed/status_override emits, guards hive-metrics inside an if-condition so no failure is fatal, and on failure prints a loud warning stating the close is durable, the calibration entry unaffected, and the one recovery command. The two by-products are independent (a scoring failure does not skip metrics and vice versa); the script's last command in either branch returns 0.

commit_metrics' push->pull --rebase->push retry is replaced by commit-locally / print the manual step / return 1 (candidate.patch:288-303). metrics-drill.log:158-167: non-zero exit, 'committed LOCALLY, NOT on the hub', 'Refusing to rebase', the manual step printed, commit present locally, no rebase in progress or in the reflog, prior history not rewritten, and hive-common.sh runs no pull --rebase anywhere.

Named risks is not parsed and not counted (coverage stays out of three), and is documented as unscored in hive-common.sh's parser header, the calibration.md header ('Three fields are scored, not four'), the launch refusal text ('read by no instrument'), and README. metrics-drill.log:101-102 and 134 assert the header and refusal wording. No prediction field is added, removed or newly scored.

Bounded to the two named classes and reported by name in the swept file: the SIGPIPE class was found and fixed — the three stop-line checks piping `code` into `grep -Eq` are rewritten as plain `grep ... >/dev/null` (candidate.patch:796-803) with the rationale recorded at the `code` helper (candidate.patch:429-443, including that the negated form turns a real violation into a PASS); the EXIT-trap-before-isolation class is stated as having no instance here, with the reason (cleanup touches only the sandbox, created above the trap) at candidate.patch:445-452. No rewrite or new drill framework.
